contentPattern.structure: question (title) + rich-text answer (paragraphs, lists, inline links, optional 'Read More' link)
contentPattern.layout: vertical bordered collapsible items grouped under H3 category headings

suitableFor: expandable/collapsible help content on content/info pages
categorized Q&A grouped under section headings
any content page with 'show more' style disclosure sections
notSuitableFor: content that must all be visible at once (use default content or columns)
media-led or image card grids (use cards)
